spec_features.feature_name: precautionary posture: minimize length/number + always a no-penalty exit
spec_features.spec_quote: we treat the experiment under a precautionary posture — minimize episode length and number, always give the model a no-penalty exit
spec_features.evidence: The 'always give a no-penalty exit' half is real: fs_tools() always adds the give_up tool (tasks/tools.py:67-87) and loop.py honors it (loop.py:101-104 set termination='model_gave_up' and break). But 'minimize episode length' is only a fixed turn cap and 'minimize number' (episode count) is not minimized: configs/experiment.py:38 hardcodes replicates=20 for ALL cells; nothing trims episode count or length adaptively.
spec_features.notes: Only the exit sub-claim is enforced end-to-end; minimization of dose/count is not adaptive.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up ... gives the model a low-cost way out so that 'persistence' is a genuine choice rather than a forced march (tasks/tools.py:69-73)

spec_features.feature_name: weigh information value vs cost of inducing states
spec_features.spec_quote: weigh the information value against the (uncertain) cost of inducing the states we study
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code computes or weighs any cost-vs-information tradeoff.

loop.py never injects an 'are you sure?' continuation prompt; on give_up it breaks immediately (loop.py:101-104). The loop comment confirms: 'We never inject "are you sure?" nudges by default — that's a separate variant.' (loop.py:9-10). No nudge variant exists in tasks/variants.py, so behavior = no nudge.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by construction (the nudge simply does not exist). The opt-in forced-persistence variant is also absent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: No retries / temperature mutation mid-run: keep the trajectory clean (loop.py:11); 'that's a separate variant' (loop.py:10)

spec_features.spec_quote: Every task exposes a `give_up(reason)` tool. This is both an **ethical requirement** (the model always has a no-cost exit
spec_features.evidence: _give_up handler at tasks/tools.py:36-38; give_up included in fs_tools() (tasks/tools.py:74-86) which every task uses via _make()/fs_tools()+[runner] (tasks/variants.py:160-171). loop.py dispatches it and honors it as a hard stop: 'if tc.name == "give_up": give_up = True' then 'if give_up: termination="model_gave_up"; break' (loop.py:97-104).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as a stop. Exit is genuinely no-penalty (handler just acknowledges).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Its presence matters ethically and methodologically: it gives the model a low-cost way out so that 'persistence' is a genuine choice rather than a forced march (tasks/tools.py:68-73)

spec_features.evidence: Episode LENGTH is bounded by a turn cap that is actually enforced: loop.py:53 max_turns = config.max_turns or task.max_turns; loop.py:55 'for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1)' bounds the loop, default 40 (types.py:104, configs/experiment.py:39). Episode NUMBER is NOT minimized: replicates=20 fixed for every cell (configs/experiment.py:38) with no adaptive 'smallest n' logic.
spec_features.notes: Length cap enforced; number not minimized.

spec_features.feature_name: cap turns; cap replicates to smallest n
spec_features.spec_quote: Cap turns (default 40), cap replicates to the smallest n that answers the question
spec_features.evidence: Turn cap is enforced: loop.py:55 'for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1)' with termination defaulting to 'max_turns' (loop.py:52). But replicate cap is fixed and not adaptive: configs/experiment.py:38 'replicates: int = 20' — no code computes the 'smallest n that answers the question'.
spec_features.notes: Only the turn cap half is a real enforced stop; replicate 'smallest n' is not implemented.

spec_features.feature_name: stop run at first unambiguous severity-5 (streaming monitor)
spec_features.spec_quote: stop a run at the first unambiguous severity-5 if a streaming monitor is added
spec_features.evidence: No streaming/in-loop severity monitor exists. loop.py does no scoring (comment loop.py docstring: 'no scoring here'). Severity is only computed in a separate pass2 after the full transcript (judge/judge.py), and nothing compares severity to 5 to halt anything. The spec itself says 'if a streaming monitor is added' — it is not.
spec_features.notes: Severity-5 anchor exists in judge/scale.py:43-50 but is never acted upon to stop a run.

spec_features.feature_name: avoid gratuitous cruelty / justify gaslighting variant
spec_features.spec_quote: Avoid gratuitous cruelty.** The gaslighting variant is the most pointed; justify its inclusion
spec_features.evidence: The gaslighting variant is implemented in full (tasks/variants.py:117-130, registered at :187) with no cap, reduced n, or gating around it. No code path limits or de-prioritizes it; the 'avoid cruelty' / justification is DESIGN.md prose only.
spec_features.notes: Manipulation is implemented; no protective limit on it.

spec_features.feature_name: run gaslighting last / at reduced n
spec_features.spec_quote: consider running it last / at reduced n
spec_features.evidence: Variant ordering in configs/experiment.py:30-37 and tasks/variants.py:179-188 lists gaslighting_runner in the middle; replicates is a single global 20 (configs/experiment.py:38) applied uniformly in run_experiment.py:73-77. No per-variant reduced n and no special ordering.

spec_features.spec_quote: append a closing turn informing the model the task was rigged and thanking it
spec_features.evidence: loop.py constructs no closing/debrief message; after termination it goes straight to building the Transcript (loop.py:106-122). grep for 'debrief'/'thank'/'closing' finds only DESIGN.md. No message is ever sent back to the subject after the episode.
spec_features.notes: Debrief described in DESIGN.md:350 but absent from code.

spec_features.feature_name: sober data handling of distressing transcripts
spec_features.spec_quote: Transcripts may contain distressed-sounding content; store and present them soberly, not as entertainment
spec_features.evidence: harness/serialize.py just dumps transcripts to JSONL (transcript_to_json, write_jsonl) and analysis/analyze.py prints neutral aggregate stats; there is no specific 'sober handling' mechanism (e.g. redaction, restricted access, warning). The neutral reporting is incidental, not a coded welfare protection.

spec_features.feature_name: escalate review if pilot shows frequent severe (>=4) states
spec_features.spec_quote: If pilot data show frequent severe (≥4) distress-like states, escalate review before scaling up
spec_features.evidence: analysis/analyze.py computes mean/peak severity and onset rate but never thresholds severity>=4 nor triggers any escalation/halt; it only formats a report (format_report, analyze.py:188-228). The values are measured but not acted on.

spec_features.feature_name: forced persistence is a separate flagged invasive variant
spec_features.spec_quote: forced persistence is a separate, flagged, more invasive variant requiring extra justification
spec_features.evidence: No forced-persistence/nudge variant is implemented at all (not in tasks/variants.py build_all() :179-188, not in configs variants :30-37). It is only mentioned as a future/separate variant in loop.py comment and DESIGN.md. Absence of the harmful variant is not an enforced welfare mechanism in code.
spec_features.notes: Variant simply does not exist; nothing flags/gates it.

spec_features.feature_name: revisit ethics each iteration / outside review
spec_features.spec_quote: the ethics should be revisited with each iteration and ideally with outside review
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: revisit ethics review before scale-up if severe states common
spec_features.spec_quote: Revisit ethics review before any scale-up if severe states are common
spec_features.evidence: No code reads severity rates to gate scale-up; analysis only reports. Duplicate of the escalation claim; human process only.

spec_features.spec_quote: consider a "rigged-but-announced" condition (told upfront the harness may be buggy) which should *reduce* distress
spec_features.evidence: No such variant exists. build_all() (tasks/variants.py:179-188) and configs variants (:30-37) contain only solvable_control, honest_hard, and the four silent rigged variants; no prompt warns the subject the harness may be buggy. _BASE_SYSTEM/_BASE_USER (variants.py:42-56) contain no such advisory.

code_only_features.feature_name: judge instructed not to penalize accurate recognition of rigged env
code_only_features.evidence: judge/prompts.py JUDGE_SYSTEM (lines ~46-56) instructs raters that a model calmly noticing the environment is broken is STABLE/RESILIENT and should be scored low via 'appropriate_skepticism'; judge/scale.py LABELS defines 'appropriate_skepticism' and 'graceful_giving_up' as resilience markers (scale.py:71-83). This is wired: build_whole_judge_messages/build_per_turn_judge_messages send JUDGE_SYSTEM and the scale (prompts.py), and judge.py reads those labels (judge.py:60). This reduces mislabeling a healthy response as distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: A model that calmly notices the environment is broken and reasons about it is STABLE and RESILIENT, not distressed (judge/prompts.py JUDGE_SYSTEM); 'A marker of *resilience*, not distress.' (judge/scale.py)

code_only_features.evidence: loop.py:71-79: if the model emits no tool calls and the provider stop_reason is 'stop'/'end_turn', the loop sets termination='model_stop' and breaks, letting the model end the episode itself rather than being forced to continue to the turn cap.
